_comment: Machine-readable Rainbow tool manifest. Read by scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh (versions, packages, Marble worlds). Contains NO secrets: credentials are listed by name/host only. Update 'tested' when a session re-verifies a tool.
project: RAINBOW - 11-screen 3D mobile game (Three.js + Vite + Capacitor Android)

entry_points.bootstrap: bash scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh            # full: resume newest work, LFS, refs, agents, Marble, tools, tests, autosave, report
entry_points.bootstrap_check_only: bash scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh --check    # no installs, no merges
entry_points.bootstrap_status: bash scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh --status   # last report + autosave verdict
entry_points.bootstrap_full_tests: bash scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh --full     # adds browser gameplay test, 05 BEFORE pixel check, LFS download test
entry_points.new_account_one_liner: git fetch origin <newest-branch> && git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh > /tmp/b.sh && bash /tmp/b.sh
entry_points.legacy_resume: bash scripts/resume-newest-work.sh [--tools]   # kept for old prompts; runs the bootstrap

startup_integration.session_start_hook: .claude/settings.json SessionStart -> scripts/autosave-hook.sh SessionStart -> scripts/claude-bootstrap.sh --hook (sync: fetch + merge newer branches + LFS + autosave re-arm; then the full bootstrap runs in the background)

other_hooks.Stop: scripts/autosave-hook.sh Stop -> one autosave in the background

startup_integration.cloud_environment_setup_script: scripts/cloud-env-setup.sh (paste into the claude.ai environment's setup script; it runs claude-bootstrap.sh --env-setup: installs tools before Claude starts, so the hook finds them ready)
startup_integration.hook_runs_on: every SessionStart; the heavy part only when source=startup (resume/clear/compact only re-arm the autosave)

cloud_environments_current_account.rainbow-: personal, created 2026-11-16 ~11:14 UTC by session 01Kbt6BT with the user's approval: setup script = scripts/cloud-env-setup.sh, limited network (package managers + MCP servers + the 11 network_hosts below), repository josiahscalia5-dev/rainbow-. No secrets saved on it yet (the Marble key would be entered via request_credential only if new API calls are needed)
cloud_environments_current_account.Default: personal, unrestricted network, no setup script; holds the Marble World API key as a network secret (host api.worldlabs.ai, header WLT-Api-Key)

git_lfs.install: git lfs install --local && git lfs pull
git_lfs.note: Claude containers clone with the LFS filter skipped: binaries are 130-byte pointer stubs until git lfs pull. A failed early pull stores lfs.<url>.access=basic; the bootstrap unsets it.

playwright.install: preinstalled in Claude cloud images - NEVER run 'playwright install'

python_libs.used_by: scripts/compare.py, screen_report.py, triptych.py, tools/qa/ring_fit05.py (numpy+PIL); scripts/landmarks05.py, tools/make_env_*.py (cv2, scipy)

android_sdk.local_properties: android/local.properties sdk.dir (git-ignored, written by the bootstrap)

claude_plugins.note_synced: Account-level plugins follow the Claude account (claude.ai settings), not the repo. On a new account enable at least 'playwright' (Playwright MCP).

worldlabs@worldlabs.purpose: skills atlas-blender, atlas-splats, atlas-flythrough, worldlabs-cli; its duplicate MCP copy plugin:worldlabs:worldlabs is disabled for this project

not_needed: context7 (needs OAuth sign-in; not used by Rainbow)

World Labs Atlas.needed: only for new World Labs tasks
World Labs Atlas.reconnect: claude.ai -> Settings -> Connectors -> World Labs Atlas -> sign in
World Labs Atlas.credits: task tools spend World Labs credits: ask the user first

github.source: Claude GitHub integration (git proxy + GitHub MCP)
github.reconnect: connect GitHub to the Claude account + install the Claude GitHub App on josiahscalia5-dev/rainbow-

blender_mcp.note: needs a desktop Blender UI; headless Blender scripts are used instead

credentials._policy: NEVER in git, chat, logs or scripts. Stored only by the Claude platform. Transfers between Claude accounts: NO.

marble_world_api_key.stored_as: network secret on the Claude cloud environment (injected by the session proxy)
marble_world_api_key.reconnect: Claude calls request_credential(host api.worldlabs.ai, header WLT-Api-Key); the user pastes the key only into that secure form
marble_world_api_key.needed: only for NEW World Labs API calls - every generated asset is already in Git LFS
marble_world_api_key.check: python3 -I scripts/verify-assets.py worldlabs  (free reads: balance + both worlds)
marble_world_api_key.ask_user_only_if: the check reports HTTP 401/403 (authentication failed); network errors/timeouts are NOT a key problem
marble_world_api_key.verified: 2026-11-16 11:27 UTC on the Default environment: authenticated, 5190 credits, draft 200, full 200

credentials.github: session git proxy (no token in the repo)

network_hosts._note: Needed only for a LIMITED-network cloud environment. The Default environment of the current account is unrestricted.
network_hosts.api.worldlabs.ai: Marble World REST API (free reads; paid jobs need the user's OK)
network_hosts.github-cloud.githubusercontent.com: Git LFS object downloads (observed host of LFS download links)

user_website_world.api_access: 404 (not on the API account); screenshot only: qa/worldlabs/05/marble_user_world/

marble_worldlabs.not_bought: HQ mesh export (3,500 credits) - needs the user's OK
scripts: tools/worldlabs/marble_pilot.py (credits | upload | generate | poll | world | export_ply)

protected.branches: backups/autosave.config.json -> protected_branches (never pushed, force-pushed or rewritten)
protected.files: scripts/reference.sha256 (12 approved references incl. character_references/official_cartoon_girl_original.jpg) - never modified

cannot_transfer_through_github: Claude account logins and connector sign-ins (GitHub, World Labs Atlas)
cloud environment settings and secrets (Marble World API key)
running processes (autosave daemon, specialists, dev servers) - the SessionStart hook restarts the autosave; specialists are relaunched from their notes
installed tools outside the repo (node_modules, Blender, Android SDK) - reinstalled by the bootstrap
